name: dead-submit-button
description: Customers report that the 'Request a demo' button on the marketing site does nothing — they click it and no confirmation ever appears. Sales is losing leads. Fix it.
bugs: public/app.js looks up the button by the wrong id (getElementById('submitBtn')) while the button's id is 'submit-btn', so it returns null and the click handler is never attached (the script throws on load)
correct_diagnosis: app.js selected the submit button with the wrong id ('submitBtn' vs the actual 'submit-btn'), so getElementById returned null and the click handler was never wired up; using the correct id attaches the handler and the confirmation appears.

reference_fix.description: Use the correct button id so the click handler attaches.
